description: ABS Motor Vehicle Census, Australia is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub and Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). Members: ABS Motor Vehicle Census; Motor Vehicle Census, Australia. Example entry: The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Motor Vehicle Census was discontinued in 2021, and detailed the total number of motor vehicles registered in each state and territory. It includes the number of registered vehicles, average age of vehicles, fuel types, Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM), Gross Combination Mass (GCM) and the year of vehicle manufacturing. Coverage is Australia, 1971 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current and non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-31. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated); other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
